title: S4-ANIM-01 — Onion skin is only a guide.
goal: Onion Skin is only a guide: turning it on for frame 2 of a two-frame drawing shows the previous pose as a ghost without changing either frame's artwork or adding history, the PNG export stays 16 x 16, and turning it off leaves everything exact.
cliOnly: sampling the ghost overlay's visible pixels and decoding the exported PNG to prove no ghost pixels (scripts/testsprite/pixibun-onion-overlay-integrity.py, tests/production/animatedExportIntegrity.spec.ts)

steps.why: The ghost of frame 1 is not part of frame 2's artwork.
The export is the drawing at native size, not the guide.
